title: Saudia-Style Stew with Ghee
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by the flavors of Saudi Arabia, infused with the richness of ghee and the depth of garlicky spices.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlicky stew spice mix and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the dense beef or lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the nostalgic diced tomatoes, Saudia-style broth, and water.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
